newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris August same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris August same store sales up.

text.p: Paul Harris Stores Inc said Thursday its August comparable store sales rose 14.3 percent.
This was the company's sixth consecutive month of double-digit comparable store sales improvements, it added.
Year-to-date same store sales were up 14.5 percent at the end of August.
August sales of $11.5 million were up six percent compared with sales of $10.8 million in 1995, Paul Harris said.

Paul Harris said August sales rose even though it operated 12 percent fewer stores this year than last year. The reduction in stores was primarily a result of elminating an underperforming division, it added.
Year-to-date sales of $87.8 million were up seven percent compared with $82.1 million a year ago.

"During August, we had a very successful launch of a new line of denim fashions under our Paul Harris Denim brand name private label, and sales of all our product categories showed improvement compared with a year ago," Charlotte Fischer, chairman, said in a statement.
